verdict.summary: A Delaware LP feeder into a credit fund can be outlined in v3 as T, register entries and a NAV, but it fits poorly in the details. No mint address is known; an LP interest has no claim kind (membership-interest is the nearest proposal); the general partner, the platform and the issuer all carry Securitize's name, which v3 cannot record as affiliation; and the oracle NAV behind the liquidity facility needs the oracle-feed proposal. Apart from the Form D, nothing that decides the holder's position is published by the party who would sign it.
